instruction: Crisp studio photograph, full shot from a high angle in a minimalist white studio. On the left, the dancer in the black hooded outfit (R1) leans backward with their head tilted up and eyes closed. On the right, the dancer in the white hooded outfit (R2) leans forward over R1, looking down. R2's right arm is draped over R1's shoulder as they lean into each other in a fluid dance movement. Bright, even studio lighting casts soft shadows on the clean white floor.
elements: R2 leans forward over R1 while R1 leans backward
R1 has their head tilted up with eyes closed while R2 looks down over R1
R2's right arm is draped over R1's shoulder
R1 and R2 lean into each other in a fluid dance movement
